ones = [0] * 17
for index in range(1, 17):
    ones[index] = ones[index - 1] * 10 + 1

def total_operations(n, i):
    total = i * (n // ones[i])
    n %= ones[i]
    if n == 0:
        return total
    optionA = i + total_operations(ones[i] - n, i - 1)
    optionB = total_operations(n, i - 1)
    return total + min(optionA, optionB)

inputVal = int(input())
